notes: Digitized from a photo of 'GHANA SHIPPERS' COUNCIL -- SERVICE CHARGE RATES PER METRIC TON' on 2026-07-14. The source document's own letterhead says 'Ghana Shippers' Council'; per explicit user instruction, this project keeps labeling the charge 'Ghana Shippers' Authority (GSA)' throughout the app regardless -- authority code stays 'GSA'. Row 3 ('Bulk Cargo') has a handwritten annotation confirmed by the user to read 'Bulk Cargo / Tanker' -- i.e. this rate applies to both bulk cargo and tanker (liquid bulk) calls, not bulk cargo alone. Row 5 (Clinker) carves out a cheaper rate than the general Bulk Cargo/Tanker rate ($0.20 vs $0.35) -- this is the real source for the rate_table GSALEVY line, which is now cargo-differentiated accordingly (see rate_engine.py's cargo_match selection logic).
